visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing a grey newsboy cap and a black sweatshirt with the 'Roots' logo, sits in a well-lit studio environment. He is wearing white wireless earbuds and gestures energetically with his hands while looking directly into the camera. Several electronics boxes are visible on the table in front of him. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a pair of bright red wireless earbuds sitting inside a matching red charging case. The case has a unique silver-rimmed dial on the corner and the text 'cmf by NOTHING' is clearly printed on the matte surface. (3) The man holds the red earbud case and demonstrates the physical rotation of the circular dial with his thumb. His facial expressions are expressive, emphasizing the product's features. (4) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a smartphone with a dedicated app interface open, displaying 'CMF' settings, equalizer adjustments, and noise cancellation toggles. A finger scrolls through the settings to demonstrate software integration. (5) The video transitions to a close-up of a silver-colored CMF Watch Pro 2 with a round face and grey strap. A hand is shown removing and replacing the watch's circular bezel, demonstrating hardware customization. (6) On the man's wrist, the smartwatch is shown displaying various health metrics like heart rate. The interface then shifts to a call notification screen, showing a green answer button and contact information.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice begins speaking Mandarin with a high-energy, friendly, and authoritative tone, characteristic of a professional tech reviewer. The background features an upbeat electronic music track with a strong 4/4 synthesized drum beat and bright synth pads. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect punctuates the introduction of the CMF brand. The speaker's delivery remains fast-paced and clear, with the music maintaining a steady rhythm. (3) As the speaker details the earbuds' features, a subtle metallic click SFX is heard to emphasize physical interactions. The music continues without interruption, serving as a rhythmic bed for the high-density speech. (4) Another synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition to the smartwatch discussion. The vocal pitch remains dynamic and engaging, highlighting the high 'CP value' (cost-performance ratio). (5) A light digital 'ping' sound effect is heard during the demonstration of the watch's bezel change. The track ends with the male voice concluding the review, followed by a quick fade out of the electronic music.
